notes.title: Shuradan Server Database Optimization
notes.content:
Dear players!

The Shuradan server database will be optimized soon. As part of this process, characters from inactive accounts will be permanently deleted from the database.

Characters from inactive accounts will be deleted based on their level:
🔻If you haven't logged in for 1 year, all characters level 1 will be deleted.
🔻If you haven't logged in for 3 years, all characters level 29 and below will be deleted.
🔻If you haven't logged in for 5 years, all characters will be deleted.

Please remember to log in to prevent your characters from being optimized. This will help you preserve your valuables and avoid losses.

Thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: GM Event: "Boss Summon"
notes.content:
Get ready to face the bosses — on August 29 we will summon them all over Azmara!

Terrible and evil dungeon bosses are tired of being constantly defeated by heroes! Seeking revenge, they decided to spread fear and terror in the nearby cities. Only the best fighters of Azmara can resist them and drive them back into the darkness! Are you ready?
Keep a close eye on the in-game news. When the appointed time comes, heroes will receive the signal of the bosses’ arrival!

Where and when the battle will take place:

Location — suburbs of all Azmara (channel 1)
Date — August 29:

Azmara-Blackforest — 17:00 UTC+3

Shuradan-Aurion — 17:30 UTC+3

Bent — Darkwing — 17:00 UTC+3

Herot — 17:30 UTC+3

Stonecrush — 18:00 UTC+3

Good luck, heroes!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Hero Skills Rebalance: Buffs, Nerfs, and New Effects
notes.content:
Mysterious forces have adjusted the magic and combat abilities of the heroes.
The Forbidden Tablet has been opened, and we can once again reveal who has gained power and who faces new trials.

Swordsman
✨Lancer✨
⚪ Wind Blade: Increased damage, duration, and required level.
⚪ Stunning Strike: Increased damage, duration, and required level.
⚪ Cyclone: Increased area of effect.
⚪ Overrun: Increased damage, required level, and MP cost.
⚪ Piercing Gaze: Buff strengthened, increased MP cost, attack rating, and physical defense, reduced duration.
⚪ Leap of Death: Increased duration.

✨Crusader✨
⚪ Wind Blade 2: Increased damage, duration, and MP cost.
⚪ Comet Spiral: Increased damage and MP cost.
⚪ Stunning Strike 2: Increased duration and MP cost.
⚪ Lone Hero: Increased duration and MP cost.

✨Dragoon✨
⚪ Comet Tail: Increased damage and MP cost.
⚪ Enforcement 2: Increased MP cost.
⚪ Deadly Thrust: Increased damage and MP cost.
⚪ Stunning Strike 2: Increased MP cost.
⚪ Lone Hero: Increased duration and MP cost.

Paladin
✨Guardian✨
⚪ Holy Aura (Holy Fire 2): Increased damage and added a new effect that reduces enemies’ physical defense.
⚪ Last Stand: Positive effect strengthened, increased level and MP requirements, changed duration.
⚪ Judgment: Increased damage, duration, and MP requirements.
❌ Holy Shield 2 — skill removed.
🆕 Roots of Wrath: Immobilizes nearby enemies and deals damage to them.

✨Templar✨
⚪ Shield Bash 2: Increased damage and required level.
⚪ Holy Grail: Now restores HP instead of MP, and no longer requires MP.
⚪ Light Stream 2: Increased required level, MP cost, and damage.
⚪ Great Cross: Increased required level, MP cost, and damage.
⚪ Sacrifice: Increased healing effect and cooldown time.

Witch
✨Priestess✨
⚪ Fire Strike 2: Increased damage, required level, and MP cost.
⚪ Healing 2: Healing effect strengthened.
⚪ Group Healing 2: Increased MP cost, reduced cooldown, improved healing effect.
⚪ Blessing of Protection 2: Increased required level and MP cost, increased cooldown, reduced effect duration, strengthened positive effect.

Rogue
Increased base HP for Duelist, Cutthroat, and Black Guard classes.

✨Duelist✨
⚪ Parry Mastery → Battle Master: Now increases the character’s total attack.
⚪ Strong Blow: Increased stun duration.
⚪ Hurricane: Now includes a dash to the target, increased range to 12 m.

✨Black Guard✨
⚪ Cleave 2: Increased damage, required level, and MP cost.
⚪ Rise of the Blood Moon: Increased required level and MP cost.
⚪ Parry Mastery 2 → Parry Master: Now an active skill that reflects received damage.
⚪ Shadow Protection 2: Increased MP cost and damage.

✨Cutthroat✨
⚪ Cleave 2: Increased damage, required level, and MP cost.
⚪ Throwing Star: Added slow debuff, increased required level and MP cost.
⚪ Parry Mastery 2 → Parry Master: Now an active skill that reflects received damage.

✨Night Stalker✨
⚪ Eviscerate: Increased damage, required level, and MP cost.

Sorceress
Increased base HP for all first and second professions.
⚪ Painful Strike: Increased total damage.
⚪ Codex of Damage (Ram): Slow effect strengthened, cooldown reduced.
❌ Occult Codex (Weaken) — skill removed.
🆕 Occult Codex (Empower): Temporarily increases movement speed.

✨Succubus✨
⚪ Mugwort Codex (Crash 2): Increased damage and required level.
⚪ Scythes of Amon-Ra: Increased buff duration and requirements.
⚪ Codex of Curse (Shackles 2): Now immobilizes enemies, increased requirements.
⚪ Codex of Damage (Ram 2): Now AoE, increased damage, duration, and requirements.
⚪ Complete Codex (Death): Increased required level and MP cost.

✨Blood Witch✨
⚪ Codex of Damage (Ram 2): Now AoE, increased damage, duration, and requirements.
⚪ Occult Codex (Gluttony): Increased required level and MP cost, improved MP drain, and strengthened debuffs.

Archer
✨Hunter✨
⚪ Volley 2: Increased required level and MP cost, increased damage.
⚪ Blinding Burst: Increased required level and MP cost, increased effect duration.
⚪ Poison Splash: Increased required level and MP cost, reduced duration, strengthened buff.
⚪ Explosive Wave 2: Increased MP cost, strengthened debuff and damage.
⚪ Wind Force: Increased required level and MP cost, reduced cooldown, weakened buff.

Cannoneer
✨Mercenary✨
⚪ Seraphim: Increased MP cost, increased buff duration.
⚪ Healer: Increased MP cost, reduced cooldown.

If you find a new bug after the maintenance, please contact technical support.
🎮 Have a great game!

notes.title: "Dwarfs" event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/fc23f3b3dcd9611cdc04c86c941534301b893ebf.png[/img]

The village is under threat due to pesky Dwarves, and we need to find out where they came from. Scout their camp, but be careful—they usually guard their territory quite fiercely. Our hopes are with you. If you need help, remember you are always welcome in our village.

If you have already reached level 70, quickly find Lucas in the village of Lupert to learn more about the Dwarves’ invasion. You will have a chain of 7 quests, and completing them will earn you a bunch of flowers to exchange for a prize box.

Also, don’t forget to visit your old friend, Gate Bregal, in Berneo, who also has a couple of quests for you. Now, defeating monsters above level 70 gives you a chance to get a “Small Flower,” which can be exchanged for a gift box.
Collect 50 Small Flowers, and Gate Bregal will help you craft the coveted Small Dwarf Box via the Crafting tab.

notes.title: Shuradan-Arkania and Aurion servers are merged!
notes.content:
Experience more action-packed gameplay as players from Shuradan-Arkania and Aurion servers unite in a single world! New friends and rivals await!

Important changes after the merge:
✨If player or guild names were identical, prefixes “s22j_” and “s35j_” are added. A name-change scroll will be granted to affected players and guild masters.
✨If you had characters on both servers, Shuradan-Arkania characters will be displayed by default. To access Aurion characters, delete the unneeded one and restore via the special merge page.
✨Items on auction have been returned via mail.
✨Account storages merged. If full, free space and relaunch the game to receive missing items.
✨GXP backpack items moved to character’s account storage. To access, free personal storage and relaunch.
✨All account storage items moved to the first character’s inventory in the selection menu. Free up inventory space and relaunch. Items will fill available slots; switching channels may be needed to retrieve all.

✅ Please do not delete characters immediately—log in first to check inventories. All player assets, mail, friend lists, etc., have been preserved!

To retrieve items from overfilled storage:

Log in with the first character.

Items will auto-add to their backpack if space allows.

Free space, switch channel to retrieve more. Repeat as needed.

🔧 If you encounter any issues, comment below or contact support.

notes.title: NEW SERVER - Stonecrush!
notes.content:
Hello, heroes!
 
We have opened a new server - Stonecrush! The north is located in Europe, but it is ready to open its doors to players from anywhere in the world. If you've been wanting to re-learn the ins and outs of your favorite game or learn any of the seven classes with their many specializations for the first time, this is the opportunity for you!
 
Define your future on the new server:
🍁Pick a character name and be the first to take it!
🍁 Choose a new character for Bosses and PvP battles!
🍁Choose a different class and pump skills from scratch!
🍁Choose how to develop your guild!
🍁Choose your path together with your friends!

You are waiting for a pure wondrous world, ready for conquest and grandiose achievements! Get in the game and become the pioneers of these lands!

The world of Karos continues to grow — welcome the new server Gerot, created especially for Latin American players! This is your moment: on this fresh server, new horizons, untouched lands, and countless opportunities await for you to start your journey from scratch. Whether you’re a seasoned warrior or a newcomer ready to explore the secrets of the world, Gerot offers a place for true heroism.

On the Gerot server, you can:

⭐Develop a guild, grow its power and influence!

The lands of Gerot are just beginning to open, and your story will be the first written in these uncharted realms. It’s time to fight, explore new lands, and grow stronger with each step! Start now — Gerot is waiting for its heroes!

notes.title: Shuradan-Eridion and Arcania servers are merged!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/d97bc930dc2a22ee95b12c7e114de159e1e68c83.png[/img]

Now the game will be more intense, and battles and fights will become even more exciting! After all, players of the Shuradan-Eridion and Arcania servers will now play together in one game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!

We ask you to familiarize yourself with the changes that have occurred due to the merger:
⭐All names of characters and guilds of the merged server that match have the prefixes "s22i_" and "s34i_" added to the beginning of the name. All characters to whom the prefix "s22i_" or "s34i_" has been added will soon be credited with a name change scroll. ⭐Guild masters to whose name the prefix "s22i_" or "s34i_" has been added will be credited with a guild name change scroll.
⭐If you had characters on both servers, then characters from the Shuradan-Eridion server will be displayed by default. In order to open access to characters from the Arkania server, you need to delete the unnecessary character and restore the desired one using a special page
⭐All items that were at the auction were returned to the mail.
⭐Account storages have been merged. If your storage is full, you need to free up space in it, then after restarting the game, the missing items will come to empty cells.
⭐Items from the GXP backpack have been placed in the character account storage. If there are no items in the Personal Storage, you need to take some things out of the storage and restart the game.
⭐All items from the account storage have been moved to the inventory of the first character in the selection menu. If your inventory is full, you should free up space in it and restart the game. The items will appear in free cells.
You may need to change the channel several times to get all the items.

❗Do not rush to delete characters immediately after merging, log in to them and check the inventory status.
Of course, all player property, their mail, friends lists and the like have been saved!

To get items from the account's overflowing storage, you will need:
⭐When logging into the server, log in as the first character in the list.
⭐Some of the items from the overflowing storage will be added to the character's main backpack.
⭐Make sure there are free slots in the main backpack, then change the channel to get some of the items from the storage.
⭐You may need to change the channel several times to get all the items.

❗If you find a bug or problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: New server - Aurion!
notes.content:
Heroes of Azmara, it's time for new achievements!

The world of Karos is expanding its horizons - meet the new server Aurion! This server, located in Europe, is open to everyone who is ready to set off on a journey through the uncharted expanses of Azmara. Whether you are an experienced warrior or just starting this path, here you will find fresh opportunities, a clean world and great challenges.

On Aurion, you choose your own destiny:

⭐️Claim the desired character name first!
⭐️Create a hero for boss battles and epic PvP battles!
⭐️Try a new class and level it up from scratch!
⭐️Develop your guild and strengthen its influence!
⭐️Go through this path from scratch with your friends!

This world is still pure and unconquered, but it is you who will write the first chapter of the story. Immerse yourself in adventures, explore new lands and temper your power! It's time to begin - Aurion is already waiting for its heroes!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Amid the hustle and bustle of the closing year and the magic of winter days, the entire GameXP team wishes you a Happy New Year! May your homes be filled with warmth, comfort, and joy, and may harmony, victories, and inspiration reign in your worlds—both real and virtual.

We are grateful to you for being with us this year, exploring new worlds, fighting shoulder to shoulder, and creating incredible stories together. We sincerely believe that the upcoming year will bring you even more exciting adventures, great achievements, and unexpected discoveries.

May the festive lights illuminate your paths like magical orbs, and kind words and gifts warm you like healing potions. May every step on your journey lead to success and joy, and may loyal allies always be by your side!

Our team is also taking a short break to return on January 9 with renewed energy and fresh ideas. However, even during the holidays, our technical support team will continue to take care of you. Response times during the break may be slightly slower than usual, but we will make sure to assist each of you.

With warmth and best wishes,
Your GameXP Team

notes.title: Event "Winter Fantasy"
notes.content:
Great to see you, hero! We have serious problems: caravans carrying supplies are increasingly being ambushed on the roads, leaving residents without essential provisions. We urgently need to uncover their plans and stop this threat.

If you’ve already reached level 50, head to Carls in Tempteron — he knows how you can help. Stay alert; challenging trials await you ahead. You’ll need to complete a chain of five quests, and upon completing them, you’ll earn a large number of "small snowflakes," which you can exchange for prize boxes.

Additionally, defeating monsters of level 50 and above now grants every hero small snowflakes. Gate Bregal promises to craft treasure boxes for every snowflake you bring him. These boxes may contain powerful artifacts, hero enhancements, and other rare gifts unavailable anywhere else in these lands. The more snowflakes you bring, the greater your chance of obtaining something truly valuable.

Boxes can be crafted in the "Crafting" tab with Gate Bregal in Berneo.

To create a Small Winter Box, you will need 50 small snowflakes. When you open the box, you are guaranteed to receive a Medium Snowflake (1 pcs) and one of the following items:

notes.title: The servers of Shuradan-Dawnspark and Eridion have merged!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/d97bc930dc2a22ee95b12c7e114de159e1e68c83.png[/img]

Now the game will be more immersive, and battles and conflicts will become even more exciting! Players from the Shuradan-Dawnspark and Eridion servers will now play together in the same game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!

Please familiarize yourself with the changes resulting from the merger: 
⭐ All character and guild names on the merged server that match will have the prefixes "s22h_" and "s33h_" added at the beginning of the name. All characters with the prefixes "s22h_" or "s33h_" will soon receive a name change scroll. Guild Masters whose guild names were modified with the prefixes "s22h_" or "s33h_" will receive a guild name change scroll. 
⭐ If you had characters on both servers, by default, the characters from the Shuradan-Dawnspark server will be displayed. To access characters from the Eridion server, you must delete the unnecessary character and restore the needed one through a special page.
⭐All items that were in the auction returned to the post office.
⭐Account vaults have been merged. If your vault is full, you need to make room in it, then after restarting the game, the missing items will come to the empty cells.
⭐ Items from the GXP backpack have been placed in your character's account storage. If the items are not in the Personal Vault, you must take some of the items out of the vault and restart the game.
⭐All items from the account vault have been moved to the first character's inventory in the selection menu. If your inventory is full, you should make room in it and restart the game. The items will appear in the empty boxes.
It may be necessary to change channel several times to get all items.
 
❗Don't rush to delete characters immediately after merging, go to them and check the status of your inventory.
Of course, all of the players' possessions, their mail, friend lists and the like have been saved!

To retrieve items from an overflowing account vault will require:
⭐When logging into the server, log in as the first character on the list.
⭐ Some of the items from the overflowing vault will be added to the character's main backpack.
⭐Make sure there are empty cells in the main backpack, then change the channel to get some of the items from the vault.
⭐You may need to change the channel several times to get all the items.
 
❗If you find a bug or problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.
 
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Ice Winds Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/37ca855954397a7d46085183e0cb4a46066235c8.jpg[/img]

Cold northern winds have come to the lands of Azmara, bringing with them the icy magic of the ancient elements. These forces enchanted monsters in every corner of the world. Because of this, they became more aggressive than they were and became a threat to the villagers. Daredevils who fought them were able to get the real ice - a powerful resource, the properties of which hide many secrets.

Ghaith Bregal was the first to notice that ice is not just a mineral, but the key to long-lost relics. He calls all the heroes to help protect the world from dangerous monsters and collect the ice to use it for the benefit of all the inhabitants.

But this task is not as easy as it seems. The ice winds have strengthened the monsters, endowing them with rage, turning each of them into a formidable foe. Gate warns: anyone who enters the battle must be prepared for a stern challenge.

By defeating monsters of level 50 and above, everyone will be able to receive a small piece of ice. For bringing a small piece of ice, the character Ghaith Bregal promises to create treasure boxes, which can hide powerful artifacts, reinforcements for heroes and other rare gifts that can't be found anywhere else in Azmara. The more ice a hero brings, the greater the chances of getting something of real value.

The boxes are created through the Crafting tab of the character Gate Bregal in Berneo.

To create a Small Ice Box, you will need 50 pieces of small ice chunks. When you open the box, you are guaranteed to get a medium ice chunk (1pc) and one of the following items:
💎Gacha Coin
💎Huge mana potion 10pcs.
💎Huge health potion 10 pcs.

💎Stone of Ancient Knowledge 10 pcs.
💎Stone of Ancient Knowledge 50 pcs.
💎Ancient Knowledge Stone 100 pcs.
💎 Luck Flower
💎Scroll of Blessed Transformation
💎Scroll of Cursed Transformation
💎Weapon enchantment scroll 5 pcs.
💎Scroll for enchanting armor 5 pcs.
💎Wind Enchantment Scroll 5 pcs.
💎Mysterious Pattern 10 pcs.

notes.title: Bent-Kezra and Darkwing server merge!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/d97bc930dc2a22ee95b12c7e114de159e1e68c83.png[/img]

Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will be even more exciting! After all, players of Bent-Kezra and Darkwing servers will now play together in the same game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!
 
Please familiarize yourself with the changes that have occurred due to the merge:
⭐All character and guild names on the merged server that match will have the prefixes “s28a_” and “s31a_” added to the beginning of the name. All characters that have had the prefix “s28a_” or “s31a_” added will be credited with a name change scroll in the near future. Guildmasters who have had “s28a_” or “s31a_” added to their name will receive a guild name change scroll.
⭐If you have had characters on both servers, characters from the Bent-Kezra server will be displayed by default. In order to access characters from the Darkwing server, you must delete the unwanted character and restore the desired one using a special page.
⭐All items that were in the auction returned to the post office.
⭐Account vaults have been merged. If your vault is full, you need to make room in it, then after restarting the game, the missing items will come to the empty cells.
⭐ Items from the GXP backpack have been placed in your character's account storage. If the items are not in the Personal Vault, you must take some of the items out of the vault and restart the game.
⭐All items from the account vault have been moved to the first character's inventory in the selection menu. If your inventory is full, you should make room in it and restart the game. The items will appear in the empty boxes.
It may be necessary to change channel several times to get all items.
 
❗Don't rush to delete characters immediately after merging, go to them and check the status of your inventory.
Of course, all of the players' possessions, their mail, friend lists and the like have been saved!

To retrieve items from an overflowing account vault will require:
⭐When logging into the server, log in as the first character on the list.
⭐ Some of the items from the overflowing vault will be added to the character's main backpack.
⭐Make sure there are empty cells in the main backpack, then change the channel to get some of the items from the vault.
⭐You may need to change the channel several times to get all the items.
 
❗If you find a bug or problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.
 
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Database optimization
notes.content:
Dear players!

In the near future, the Karos game database will be optimized. As part of this process, characters of inactive accounts will be deleted from the database without the possibility of recovery.

Characters of inactive accounts will be deleted depending on their level:
- If you have not logged in for 1 year - all level 1 characters.
- If you have not logged in for 3 years - all characters level 29 and below.
- If you have not logged in for 5 years - all characters.

Don't forget to log in to keep your characters from being optimized. This way, you will be able to keep your values and avoid losses.

Thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: Angel's weapon is already in the game!
notes.content:
The battles have never ceased for a moment on the expanses of Azmara, and the enemies are constantly increasing in strength. The best blacksmiths of the Dwarf village, hidden from the eyes of others, worked day and night to create a new weapon that will fight back the forces of darkness. The main material for the creation were the feathers of the Angels, which contained the holy power.Now everyone can become the owner of the weapon “Angel”, if they can get it. The Dwarves have shared their recipe for creating this miracle. So hurry up and get equipped and go to get the necessary resources!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/4c610d198162206307e512b1a592f264ab9c0353.png[/img]
 
To create a new 107 weapon you will need: Ancient Feather (100 pcs), Large Adamantium (1 pc), Ancient Weapon Recipe (1 pc). After collecting all the necessary resources, go to Pluor at the Outpost, he will help you create this marvelous weapon.
 
You can get the Feather of the Ancients from Neo-bosses. Large adamantium can be obtained by defeating Nava bosses. The Ancient Weapon Recipe drops from any monsters of level 106 or higher.
 
Nava bosses from which there is a chance to get Big Adamantium:
⭐Dark Kakanteros
⭐Dark King Richitt
⭐Dark Demon
⭐Dark Snow Queen
⭐Dark Ballista
⭐Dark White Winged Man ⭐
⭐Dark king of the infernal creatures
⭐ Ice Talos

notes.title: "Dwarfs" event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/fc23f3b3dcd9611cdc04c86c941534301b893ebf.png[/img]

Welcome, traveler. The village is threatened by the pesky Dwarfs, we need to find out where they came from. Scout their camp, but be careful, they tend to guard their territories pretty tightly. Our hopes are with you. If you need help, remember that you are always welcome in our village.

If you have already conquered level 70, hurry up and find Lucas from Lupert Village to learn the details of the Dwarf invasion. In total, you'll have a string of 7 quests to complete, which will earn you a huge armful of flowers to exchange for a prize box.

Also don't forget to visit your old friend, Ghaith Bregal, in Berneo, he also has a couple of tasks for you. After all, now for defeating monsters above level 70 there is a chance to get a "Flower", which can be exchanged for a box of gifts. notes.title: Event - Honey Battle!
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes!
 
A huge number of wild bees have appeared on the expanses of Azmara, so we need your help!

Quickly find Ghaith in the Berneo location and find out from him what the reason for this invasion is! After that, take the honey pots from Anne and go to the sweet gathering!
 
For killing mobs above level 40 you will receive "Honey".
 
Also "Honey" can restore 30% of your health once every 10 minutes. So if you want something sweet, you can eat a piece of honey!
 
Collect the required number of items and take them to Ghaith. He will exchange them for special boxes, from which there is a chance to get a suit with a unique characteristic that multiplies the experience you get!
 
Players of level 40-89 can get a "Honeybee Box" or "Sealed Honeybee Box", while players above level 90 can get an "Improved Honeybee Box" or "Improved Sealed Honeybee Box". The level of the costume you receive depends on your character's level.
 
To obtain a "Honey Battle Box" or "Improved Honey Battle Box" you will need 10 honey and 1 pot.
 
One of the following items may fall out of the box:
 
🐝VIP status (3 days).

You will need 1 honey to obtain a "Sealed Honey Box" or "Improved Sealed Honey Box". Additionally, you need the Key to the Happy Cube to open the box. One of the following items may fall out of the box:

The level of the costume depends on the box you open. Boxes for level 40-89 players drop a level 40 costume, and boxes for players above level 90 drop a level 90 costume.

Set Bonus:

notes.title: SERVER MERGE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/369943fce928879ee5d16177cca9688108c08950.png[/img]

Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, players of servers Shuradan-Fortunas and Cyrus, servers Bent and Kezra will now play together in two game worlds, and therefore will find new friends and opponents! Meet the updated servers - Shuradan-Cyrus and Bent-Kezra!

Please familiarize yourself with the changes that have taken place due to the merge:
🍀All character and guild names on the merged server that match will have prefixes added to the beginning of the name.
Players from the Shuradan-Fortunas and Cyrus servers will get the prefixes “s30f_” and “s22f_”. And players from the Bent and Kezra servers will have the prefixes “s28_” and “s29_”.
All characters who have had their prefixes added will soon be credited with a name change scroll. Guildmasters who have had the prefix “s30f_”, “s22f_”, “s28_” or “s29_” added to their name will receive a guild name change scroll.
🍀If you had characters on both servers, characters from the Shuradan-Fortunas and Bent server will be displayed by default. In order to access characters from Cyrus and Kezra servers, you need to delete the unnecessary character and restore the necessary one using a [url=http://help.gamexp.ru/selfhelp/gamechar_restore.php]special page[/url]
🍀All items that were in the auction have returned to the post office.
🍀Account storage has been merged. If your vault is full, you need to make room in it, then after restarting the game missing items will come to empty cells.
🍀 Items from the GXP backpack have been placed in the character's account vault. If the items are not in the Personal Vault, then you must take some of the items out of the vault and restart the game.
🍀All items from the account vault have been moved to the first character's inventory in the select menu. If your inventory is full, you should make room in it and restart the game. The items will appear in the empty boxes.
🍀You may need to change the channel several times to get all items.
 
❗Don't rush to delete characters immediately after merging, go to them and check the status of the inventory.
Of course, all of the players' possessions, their mail, friend lists and the like have been saved!
 
❗❗To retrieve items from overflowing account storage, you will need to:
1. When logging into the server, log in as the first character on the list.
2. Some of the items from the overflowing storage will be added to the character's main backpack.
3. Make sure that there are free cells in the main backpack, then change the channel to get some of the items from the vault.
4. You may need to change channel several times to get all items.

If you find a bug or problem, please contact technical support.
 
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The event "First Flowers"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/eccee6bb1092cf623f0eb285d5a5efd85e766133.png[/img]

Spring has brought the first flowers to the world of Azmara, and they sprinkled all the fields and hills. But it turned out that flowers are a favorite snack of the monsters inhabiting the world, and the beautiful flower fields quickly disappeared. So, heroes of Azmara, we need your help! The character Gate Bregal is already waiting for adventurers in Berneo to tell them the details!
 
Now from any monster above level 50, there is a chance to get the Tulips needed to make the "Spring Flowers Box".
Collect 50 Tulips and Gate Bregal will help you craft the coveted box.
 
One of the listed items may fall out of the box:
⭐Azmaran gold coin 5 pieces.
⭐Ancient Knowledge Stone 30 pcs.
⭐ Potion of Concentration (1 hour)
⭐ Champion's Emblem
⭐ Green Sakura Weapon Coupon
⭐ Blue Cherry Tree Weapon Coupon
⭐ Necklace of Life (1 day)
⭐ Experience Ring (1 day)
⭐ Lucky Earrings (1 day)
⭐Potion of acceleration 5 pcs.
⭐Huge Health Potion 20 pcs.
⭐Huge mana potion 20 pcs.
⭐ Potion of vitality of the game assistant 2 pcs.
⭐ Weapon Defense
⭐ Green Light Wings Box (14 days)
⭐ Green Light Wings Box (3 days)
⭐Imbic Tea 5 pcs.

"Spring Event Box" can be purchased from the GXP store.

From it, you have a chance to get one of the following items:
⭐Green Light Wings Box (eternal)
⭐ Box of Green Light Wings (30 days)
⭐ Box of Green Light Wings (14 days)
⭐ Great Potion of Experience (3 hours)
⭐ Box of Green Light Wings (7 days)
⭐ Experience Ring (1 day)
⭐Happy earrings (1 day)
⭐ A large potion of health restoration
⭐ Necklace of Life (1 day)
⭐Platinum Concentration Potion (1 hour) 2 pcs.
⭐Weapon Protection 2 pcs.
⭐Protect armor 2 pcs.
⭐Happy Cube Key 2 pcs.
⭐ Large Mana Restoration Potion 2 pcs.
⭐Super Accelerator [Non-Transfer] 3 pcs.
⭐ MV Potion 3 pcs.
⭐Vrokian Extract 5 pcs.
⭐Gacha Coin [Non-Transfer] 5 pcs.

Green Light Wings boxes are passed around. If you printed the box and took the wings out of it, the wings cannot be transferred.
 
The appearance of Green Light wings:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/cb6e313f2c07bd2d72d4299b634f753bee37eb51.jpg[/img]

Unused Tulips will be removed at the end of the event.
The event will last until April 10.
 
We wish you an enjoyable game!

notes.title: Valentine's Day Event!
notes.content:
Valentine's Day Event!

Dear players!

Valentine's Day is perhaps the most romantic holiday in the world. On February 14, billions of people will confess their love. They give their halves cute gifts, arrange a festive dinner and fill the house with bright feelings. In honor of this holiday, an event for St. Valentine's Day or For all lovers has started!

Now from monsters from level 50, players from level 50 will be able to knock out an event item:
"Valentine", which must be taken to NPC Gate Bregal, in Berneo.

During the event, you will have to go through a chain of 15 quests.

As a reward for each quest, you can get some of the following items in different amounts:

💖Hot chocolate
💖marmalade heart
💖 chocolate heart
💖Stone of Ancient Knowledge
💖 Superior Stone of the Wise
💖Vrockian extract
💖Azmar Gold Coin
💖carats

The higher the quest, the tastier the reward!

[b]As a reward for the last quest number 15, you will become the owner of a unique level 90 exorcist costume for 15 days!
[/b]
[b]The event will last until 02/21/2024.
[/b]
Collect all the valentines to get into the holiday spirit!

notes.title: MERGE SERVERS SHURADAN-FLOATSTONE AND FORTUNAS!
notes.content:
Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, players of Shuradan-Floatstone and Fortunas servers will now play together in one game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!
 
Please familiarize yourself with the changes that have taken place due to the merge:
⭐All character and guild names of the merged server that match are added with the prefixes "s22e_" and "s27e_" at the beginning of the name. All characters that have had the prefix "s22e_" or "s27e_" added will be credited with a name change scroll in the near future. Guildmasters who have had "s22e_" or "s27e_" added to their name will receive a guild name change scroll.
⭐If you have had characters on both servers, characters from the Shuradan-Floatstone server will be displayed by default. In order to open access to characters from the Fortunas server, you need to delete the unwanted character and restore the necessary one with the help of a special page
⭐All items that were in the auction returned to the post office.
⭐Account vaults have been merged. If your vault is full, you need to make room in it, then after restarting the game, the missing items will come to the empty cells.
⭐ Items from the GXP backpack have been placed in your character's account storage. If the items are not in the Personal Vault, you must take some of the items out of the vault and restart the game.
⭐All items from the account vault have been moved to the first character's inventory in the selection menu. If your inventory is full, you should make room in it and restart the game. The items will appear in the empty boxes.
It may be necessary to change channel several times to get all items.
 
❗Don't rush to delete characters immediately after merging, go to them and check the status of your inventory.
Of course, all of the players' possessions, their mail, friend lists and the like have been saved!

To retrieve items from an overflowing account vault will require:
⭐When logging into the server, log in as the first character on the list.
⭐ Some of the items from the overflowing vault will be added to the character's main backpack.
⭐Make sure there are empty cells in the main backpack, then change the channel to get some of the items from the vault.
⭐You may need to change the channel several times to get all the items.
 
❗If you find a bug or problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.
 
Enjoy the game!

We are happy to announce the launch of our new Cyrus and Kezra servers! They simultaneously open their doors for new heroes!
 
Cyrus server will be glad to all players from Russia and Europe, here for them will be the most comfortable ping in the game.
 
Kezra server opens its doors to all players from Latin America. This server is exactly the same as the server Bent, so the ping for residents of the nearest regions promises to be very comfortable.
 
If you've been wanting to re-learn the ins and outs of your favorite game or learn any of the seven classes with their many specializations for the first time, now is the time!
 
Define your future on the new servers:

A pure wondrous world awaits you, ready for conquest and grandiose accomplishments! Get in the game and become the pioneers of these lands!

notes.title: FAN ART CONTEST!
notes.content:
We are announcing a fanart contest! We know that there are a lot of talented people among you, so we offer you to take part in our drawing contest! The contest will be held on the Discord platform.
 
[b]Your task[/b]: to draw art on the theme of Winter. You can draw anything you want, but your character or pet from the game must be present on the drawing.
 
❗ Works are accepted only in the corresponding channel in Discord: [url=https://discord.com/channels/620535438935064586/1184497152941117523]🎨fan-art-contest🖌[/url].
You can join Discord at [url=https://discord.gg/kaSSRuzRZ6]link[/url] 
 
[b]Artwork Requirements:[/b]
🔸 we do not limit your imagination, but the theme must correspond to the stated;
🔸 works that do not match the theme will be disqualified;
🔸 only one work per participant;
🔸 work can be on paper or in digital format;
🔸 the use of AI is prohibited;
🔸 when publishing a finished work, you must attach the stages of the work;
🔸 you must attach a screenshot of your character/pet that you used as a reference with the finished work;
🔸 plagiarism, misappropriation and other copyright infringements are strictly prohibited;
🔸 depiction of pornographic scenes is prohibited;

[b]Deadlines: [/b]
🔸 entries will be accepted from December 13 to January 7, 2024, inclusive.
🔸 winners will be determined by 23:59 on January 10.

[b]Judging Criteria:[/b]
🔸 idea
🔸 relevance to the theme
🔸 execution
🔸 correspondence of the character or pet to its prototype from the game 
🔸 detail

[b]Awards:[/b]
🔸 1st place - 100 GXP
🔸 2nd place - 50 GXP
🔸 3rd place - 30 GXP
🔸 Audience Award - 10 GXP + VIP for 7 days.
 
The Audience Award is given to the participant who got the most reactions ❤️ under their work. 

❗ Please note, if your work has gained the most hearts, but you have not posted the stages of the work and the reference of your character/pet, you will be disqualified regardless of the number of reactions.
 
Prepare everything you need to draw and participate! We wish you all the best of luck!

notes.title: NEW YEAR'S JACKPOT!
notes.content:
🎄You have a unique opportunity to participate in the New Year Jackpot.🎄

🎄What is the Jackpot?

The Jackpot is a great opportunity to get some of the most expensive and useful items at a mind-blowing discount, as well as win GXP!
The final size of the Jackpot is unlimited and its current amount is available on the main page of the site!

🎄 How is the prize pool formed?

When buying each product, a part of the funds is allocated to the accumulated prize fund of the Jackpot, which will be drawn among the participants! The amount accumulated during the campaign period will be drawn at the end of the campaign on December 29 between the Karos players participating in the Jackpot.

🎄 How is the rewarding done?

A prize of 50% of the accumulated amount will be awarded to 3 winners and the remaining 50% will be distributed among the remaining 10 winners.

🎄When can I find out the results and claim my prize?

Jackpot results will be announced within 3 business days after the end of the promotion.

The winning GXPs will be credited to the winners' accounts within three business days.

When you buy a special item, you will definitely get two items at a big discount!

🎄You can participate in the jackpot from December 14 to December 28 (inclusive).

notes.title: COMBINING SHURADAN-BRIDGEVILLE AND FLOATSTONE SERVERS!
notes.content:
Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, players of the Shuradan-Bridgeville and Floatstone servers will now play together in the same game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!

[b]We ask you to familiarize yourself with the changes that have occurred in connection with the merger:[/b]
[list]
[*] All names of characters and guilds of the combined server that match, the prefixes "s22d_" and "s26d_" are added at the beginning of the name. All characters to whom the prefix "s22d_" or "s26d_" has been added will be credited with a name change scroll in the near future. The masters of the guilds, to the name of which the prefix "s22d_" or "s26d_" has been added, will be credited with a scroll to change the guild name.
[*] If you had characters on both servers, then characters from the Shuradan-Bridgeville server will be displayed by default. In order to open access to characters from the Floatstone server, it is necessary to delete an unnecessary character and restore the desired one using a special page
[*] All the things that were at the auction were returned to the post office.
[*] Account repositories have merged. If your storage is full, then you need to free up space in it, then after restarting the game, the missing items will come to empty cells.
[*] The items from the GXP backpack were placed in the character's account vault. If there are no items in the Personal Storage, then you need to get some items out of the storage and restart the game.
[*] All items from the account's storage have been moved to the first character's inventory in the selection menu. If your inventory is full, you should free up space in it and restart the game. Items will appear in free cells.
[*] It may be necessary to change the channel several times to get all the items.
[/list]
 
[b]Do not rush to delete characters immediately after merging, go to them and check the status of the inventory.[/b]
Of course, all the players' possessions, their mail, friend lists and similar things were saved!
 
[b]To get items from an overflowing account storage, you will need:[/b]
[list]
[*] When logging into the server, enter the game as the first character in the list.
[*] Some items from the overflowing storage will be added to the main backpack of the character.
[*] Make sure that there are free cells in the main backpack, then change the channel to get some items from the storage.
[*] To get all the items, you may need to change the channel several times.
[/list]

 
If you find an error or problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.
 
Have a nice game!

notes.title: REBALANCING THE SECOND PROFESSION OF THE CLASS VEDUNIA: PRIESTESS!
notes.content:
Witches are mysterious magicians capable of rewriting the very foundations of the world. This time they decided to rewrite the history of the Church - with the unique ability to strengthen the strength and survival of their comrades in battle. The Priestess is a representative of the Churches, unshakably loyal to her comrades, always ready to provide them with support and assistance at the most difficult moment.
 
MEET THE PRIESTESS REBALANCING!
 
CHURCH

• The area of effect of the "Group Healing" skill has been significantly increased.
 
PRIESTESS

• The skill "Blessing of Protection II" now blocks 30% of damage taken. The duration of the skill is 20 seconds. Recovery 60 seconds.
 
• The skill "Heal II" now additionally restores 10% of the target's health. Cast time increased to 2 seconds.
 
• The skill "Group Healing II" additionally restores 20% of the target's health. Cast time increased to 3 seconds. Area of effect greatly increased
 
These figures are relevant for the maximum level of the skill. At lower levels, the numbers will be different.
 
We are closely following your feedback and wishes and look forward to your comments in our VK and Discord group.

notes.title: FLETTAREVOLUTION!
notes.content:
The magic power of Azmara's world changed its trajectory, which resulted in significant changes in the balance.
 
Heroes of Azmara, meet Flett's updated skills!
 
CHANGING SKILLS


YAN

• Level 1 - Health +2%
• Level 2 - Health +4%
• Level 3 - Health + 6%
• Level 4 - Health + 8%
• Level 5 - Health + 11%
• Level 6 - Health + 15%

YIN

• Level 1 - Skill recovery time -2%
• Level 2 - Skill cooldown time -4%
• Level 3 - Skill Cooldown Time -6%
• Level 4 - Skill cooldown -8%
• Level 5 - Skill cooldown -10%
• Level 6 - Skill cooldown time -15%

AIR

• Level 1 - Attack Speed + 9%
• Level 2 - Attack Speed + 12%
• Level 3 - Attack Speed + 15%
• Level 4 - Attack Speed + 18%
• Level 5 - Attack Speed + 21%
• 6 level - Attack speed + 24%

FIRE

• Level 1 - Skill casting speed + 20%, Crit chance + 2%
• Level 2 - Skill application speed + 40%, Crit chance + 2.5%
• Level 3 - Skill casting speed + 60%, Crit chance + 3%
• Level 4 - Skill application speed + 80%, Crit chance + 3.5%
• Level 5 - Skill casting speed + 100%, Crit chance + 4%
• Level 6 - Skill casting speed + 120%, Crit chance + 4.5%

TREE

• Level 1 - Steal health + 5%
• Level 2 - Steal health + 10%
• Level 3 - Steal health + 15%
• Level 4 - Steal health + 20%
• Level 5 - Steal health + 25%
• 6 level - Steal health + 30%

EARTH

• Level 1 - Attack power + 6%
• Level 2 - Attack power + 9%
• Level 3 - Attack power + 12%
• Level 4 - Attack power + 16%
• Level 5 - Attack power + 22%
• 6 level - Attack power + 30%

WATER

• Level 1 - Movement Speed + 4%, Healing Efficiency + 4%
• Level 2 - Movement speed + 6%, Healing efficiency + 7%
• Level 3 - Movement speed + 8%, Healing efficiency + 10%
• Level 4 - Movement speed + 10%, Healing efficiency + 13%
• Level 5 - Movement speed + 12%, Healing efficiency + 16%
• Level 6 - Movement speed + 14%, Healing efficiency + 20%

 
ADDITIONAL SKILLS WHEN MAXIMIZING EFFECTS.


• Effect of air (level 6) - reduces the chance of an opponent's crit by 15%. Action time 10 seconds.
• The effect of fire (level 6) - reduces the physical and magical protection of the enemy by 15%. Action time 10 seconds.
• Tree effect (level 6) - reduces the enemy's movement speed by 100%. Action time 4 seconds.
• Earth effect (level 6) - stuns the enemy. Duration 2 seconds.
• Water effect (level 6) - reduces the enemy's attack speed by 10%. Action time 5 seconds.

 
ATTACKING SKILLS


• Yin (level 6) + air effect (level 6) - reduces the chance of an opponent's critical hit by 30%. Action time 10 seconds.
• Yin (level 6) + fire effect (level 6) - reduces the enemy's physical and magical defense by 40%. Action time 10 seconds.
• Yin (level 6) + tree effect (level 6) - reduces the enemy's movement speed by 100%. The duration is 8 seconds.
• Yin (level 6) + earth effect (level 6) - stuns the enemy. Action time 4 seconds.
• Yin (level 6) + water effect (level 6) - reduces the enemy's attack speed by 40%. Action time 5 seconds.

All offensive skills can now automatically trigger with a certain chance when dealing damage to an enemy with a hand or using an offensive ability.
 
DEFENSIVE SKILLS


• Yang (level 6) + air effect (level 6) - Increases defense rating by 100 and dodge rating by 100. Lasts 10 seconds.
• Yang (level 6) + fire effect (level 6) - increases damage reflection by 100%. Action time 5 seconds.
• Yang (level 6) + tree effect (level 6) - restores 1% of health every second. Action time 20 seconds.
• Yang (level 6) + earth effect (level 6) - increases damage resistance by 30%. Action time 20 seconds.
• Yang (level 6) + water effect (level 6) - slightly increases defense and resistance to negative effects. Action time 15 seconds.

[b]The fletta stats of all characters have been reset and the points returned.[/b]

We are closely following your feedback and wishes and look forward to your comments in our VK and Discord group.

notes.title: Event Flowers collect!
notes.content:
Hello hero!
 
Let's color the last days of summer with a new and exciting event! The summer fields in beautiful Azmara are always adorned with a variety of flowers blooming in vibrant hues. Why not collect some beautiful bouquets of beautiful tulips and dandelions?

Go to the NPC Gate Bregal in the Berneo location, demand event quests from him and take flowers from monsters of level 50 and above.
 
Collect the required number of items and take them to NPC Gate Bregal. He will help you craft a Summer Gift for 30 tulips and 30 dandelions. And for 5 tulips and 5 dandelions you will get 3 Summer Flower Cubes.
 
In order to open the Cube of Summer Flowers, you will need the Key to the Lucky Cube.

The regular Summer Gift does not require a Lucky Cube Key.
 
More information about the contents of the Summer Gift and the Cube of Summer Flowers can be found below:

notes.title: New event - Honey Battle!
notes.content:
Hello heroes!
 
A huge number of wild bees have appeared in the expanses of Azmara, so we need your help!

Rather, find NPC Gate Bregal in the Berneo location and find out from him what is the reason for this invasion! Then take the pots for honey from NPC Anna and go on!
 
For killing mobs above level 40, you will receive "Honey".
 
Also, "Honey" can restore you 30% of health once every 10 minutes. Therefore, if you want something sweet, then feel free to eat a honey!
 
Collect the required number of items and take them to NPC Gate Bregal. He will exchange them for special boxes, from which there is a chance to get a suit with a unique characteristic that increases the experience gained!
 
Players level 40-89 can get a "Honey Battle Box" or "Sealed Honey Battle Box", and players above level 90 an "Improved Honey Battle Box" or "Improved Sealed Honey Battle Box". The level of the received costume depends on the level of your character.
 
To craft a  "Honey Battle Box" or "Improved Honey Battle Box" you need 10 honey and 1 pot for honey.

notes.title: COMBINATION OF SHURADAN-ROWELSTONE AND BRIDGEVILLE SERVERS!
notes.content:
Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, the players of the Shuradan-Rowelstone and Bridgeville servers will now play together in the same game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!

Please read the changes that have taken place in connection with the merger:
• All character and guild names of the merged server that match will have "s22c_" and "s25c_" added to the beginning of the name. All characters who have been added the prefix "s22c_" or "s25c_" will soon be credited with a name change scroll. Guild Masters with the prefix "s22c_" or "s25c_" added to their name will receive a guild name change scroll.
 
• If you had characters on both servers, then the characters from the Shuradan-Rowelstone server will be displayed by default. In order to open access to characters from the Bridgeville server, you need to delete an unnecessary character and restore the one you need using a special page on the game website.
 
• All items that were at the auction returned to the post office.
 
• Merged account repositories. If your storage is full, then you need to free up space in it, then after restarting the game, the missing items will come to empty cells.
 
• Items from the GXP backpack have been placed in the character's account storage. If there are no items in the Personal Storage, then you need to get some of the things from the storage and restart the game.
 
• All items from the account storage have been moved to the inventory of the first character in the selection menu. If your inventory is full, you should free up space in it and restart the game. Items will appear in free cells.
It may be necessary to change the channel several times to get all the items.
Do not rush to delete the characters immediately after the merger, go to them and check the status of the inventory.

• Of course, all players' belongings, their mail, friends lists and the like have been saved!

To get items from an overflowing account storage, you will need:
1. When entering the server, enter the game as the first character in the list.
2. Part of the items from the overflowing storage will be added to the character's main backpack.
3. Make sure that there are free slots in the main backpack, then change the channel to get some of the items from the storage.
4. To get all the items, you may need to change the channel several times.

If you find a bug or problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.
 
Have a nice game!

notes.title: COMBINATION OF SHURADAN-MACTRAY AND ROWELSTONE SERVERS!
notes.content:
Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, the players of the Shuradan-Maktroy and Rowelstone servers will now play together in the same game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!

Please read the changes that have taken place in connection with the merger:
• All character and guild names of the merged server that match will have "s22b_" and "s24b_" added to the beginning of the name. All characters who have been added the prefix "s22b_" or "s24b_" will soon be credited with a name change scroll. Guild Masters with the prefix "s22b_" or "s24b_" added to their name will receive a guild name change scroll.
 
• If you had characters on both servers, then the characters from the Shuradan-Maktra server will be displayed by default. In order to open access to characters from the Rowelstone server, you need to delete an unnecessary character and restore the one you need using a special page on the game website.
 
• All items that were at the auction returned to the post office.
 
• Merged account repositories. If your storage is full, then you need to free up space in it, then after restarting the game, the missing items will come to empty cells.
 
• Items from the GXP backpack have been placed in the character's account storage. If there are no items in the Personal Storage, then you need to get some of the things from the storage and restart the game.
 
• All items from the account storage have been moved to the inventory of the first character in the selection menu. If your inventory is full, you should free up space in it and restart the game. Items will appear in free cells.
It may be necessary to change the channel several times to get all the items.
Do not rush to delete the characters immediately after the merger, go to them and check the status of the inventory.

• Of course, all players' belongings, their mail, friends lists and the like have been saved!

To get items from an overflowing account storage, you will need:
1. When entering the server, enter the game as the first character in the list.
2. Part of the items from the overflowing storage will be added to the character's main backpack.
3. Make sure that there are free slots in the main backpack, then change the channel to get some of the items from the storage.
4. To get all the items, you may need to change the channel several times.

If you find a bug or problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.
 
Have a nice game!

[/list]

notes.title: Combining Shuradan and McTroy servers!
notes.content:
Now the game will be more intense, and battles and battles will become even more exciting! After all, the players of the McTroy and Shuradan (New Azmara) servers will now play together in the same game world, which means they will find new friends and opponents!


Please read the changes that have taken place in connection with the merger:


[list]
[*] All the names of characters and guilds of the joint server that match, are added the prefixes "s22a_" and "s23a_" at the beginning of the name. All characters who have been added the prefix "s22a_" or "s22a_" will soon be credited with a name change scroll. Guild Masters with the prefix "s22a_" or "s23a_" added to their name will receive a guild name change scroll.
[/list]
[list]
[*] If you had characters on both servers, then characters from the Shuradan (New Azmara) server will be displayed by default. In order to open access to characters from the McTroy server, you need to delete the unwanted character and restore the one you need using a special technical support page.
[/list]
[list]
[*] All items that were at the auction were returned to the post office.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Account repositories have been merged. If your storage is full, then you need to free up space in it, then after restarting the game, the missing items will come to empty cells.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Items from the GXP backpack have been placed in the character's account storage. If there are no items in the Personal Storage, then you need to get some of the things from the storage and restart the game.
[/list]
[list]
[*] All items from the account storage have been moved to the inventory of the first character in the selection menu. If your inventory is full, you should free up space in it and restart the game. Items will appear in free cells. It may be necessary to change the channel several times to get all the items. [b]Don't rush to delete characters immediately after merging, go to them and check the inventory status.[/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*] Of course, all the property of the players, their mail, lists of friends and the like were saved!
[/list]



[b]To get items from an overflowing account storage, you will need:
[/b]

[olist]
[*] When entering the server, enter the game as the first character in the list.
[*] Some of the items from the overflowing storage will be added to the character's main backpack.
[*] Make sure that there are free slots in the main backpack, then change the channel to get some of the items from the storage.
[*] It may be necessary to change the channel several times to get all the items.
[/list]


If you find a bug or problem, please report it in the comments or contact technical support.
 
Have a nice game!

notes.title: New rank - external GM
notes.content:
Fighters, we are pleased to inform you about the creation of a new position in Karos and Karos Classic - external GM. Who is this and what do they eat, you ask?

And we will answer that this title was earned by our most active players who, by blood and sweat, sought changes in the game, and have always been for justice, law and order. We have been looking closely at our participants for a long time, and now, after spending long hours choosing worthy ones, we are ready to present them to you:

💥[Guardian] Ulcer - Azmara-Blackforest
💥DeathGun - McTroy
💥Sasaki - McTroy
💥Kus - McTroy
💥PamParamPam - Shuradhan
💥Amanti - Azmara-Blackforest

So what will outside GMs do? Keep order on the server, and also be able to block cheaters. Have you noticed a person who is clearly using third-party software? Rather, turn to the external GM - this sheriff is always on guard of his possessions! Quick expertise, willingness to help and impartiality are the main qualities of these players.

Meet new representatives of the law, remember that we are always open to your suggestions, and let's make the world of Azmara a better place together!

notes.title: New server Nabidan
notes.content:
Fighters, you've been waiting, you've been hoping, and here it is - a new server! We present to your attention Nabidan - an unusual place that will allow you to remember those wonderful times of Karos, when newcomers and old-timers had equal opportunities 💪🏻

What does it mean? Did communism come to Karos? Not quite, but close! Interesting features of Nabidan that will definitely not leave you indifferent:

🔥 This server is the twin brother of our beloved Azmara-Blackforest. This means that all your characters will be saved with the same nicknames and the same levels, but there is one "but".

🔥 We have come to a compromise between our wise old-timers and active newcomers: only those characters whose level is above 36 have been transferred to the new server from Azmara-Blackforest! This means that experienced players will be able to keep their favorite heroes at the same level, while newcomers will have an incredible opportunity to catch up with old-timers on new characters. How so?

🔥 All heroes will come to this server with a clean past: there will be no carats, armor, items - in a word, new opportunities to plunge into the farm and search for equipment. Welcome to the start of the journey!

🔥 World without Guilds. For a long time I wanted to found a brotherhood, but the decision was postponed from time to time due to great competition? Nabidan is literally created in order to start writing his story from scratch!

Did you want it? You got it! And we don't intend to stop there. Right now we are working on improving the game and we will be glad if you continue to send us your cool ideas and wishes. We will be happy to read all suggestions!

See you in the open spaces of Nabidan, fighters!

notes.content:
HELLO PLAYERS!

From January 1, 2022, the price of GXP rises to 25 rubles... This indexation was dictated by the inflation rate since 2018. Over the past years, we have maintained a stable price level, however, due to the emerging circumstances, this measure is necessary. All discounts of the GXP club remain with its members.


Until January 1st, GXP prices are guaranteed NOT to increase!


In the coming year, we will prepare even more first-class discounts and the best deals just for you!


Thank you for your attention. We hope for your understanding!
 
Sincerely,
Project administration.

notes.title: Stars of Victory
notes.content:
Dear friends!
 
The "Stars of Victory" event has come to the vastness of the world of Karos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7391912/975cfc53839f8240c96cd07b185488d4f8515632.jpg[/img]
 
At Berneo Gate, Bregal has already prepared a new quest for the adventurers!
 
First, contact him to start quest [b] "Stars of Victory" [/b].
 
Now, from any monster above level 10, as a loot, you have a chance to get a Victory Star - an item needed to make a holiday box.
Collect five Victory Stars and take them to Gate Bregal. As a reward you will receive a magic [b] Box for the Victory Day [/b].
 
You can find out more about the contents of the Boxes for the Victory Day from the list below:

[list]
[*] Medium Recovery Potion - 10
[*] Huge Health Potion - 10
[*] Huge Mana Potion - 10
[*] Scroll for enchanting armor - 1
[*] Scroll for enchanting weapons - 1
[*] Potion of experience (1 day) - 1

We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: ДОБРО ПОЖАЛОВАТЬ НА НОВЫЙ СЕРВЕР БЕРНЕО!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7391912/5c9b183f7a06600370a16c580d8234d744ba3d16.jpg[/img]

Герои Азмары, мы рады представить вам новый сервер - Бернео! Сервер был назван в честь одной из популярных локаций игры. В нём будут доступны 3 канала. 
 
В чём преимущества нового игрового мира? Только здесь у вас есть уникальная возможность начать всё с чистого листа и на равных условиях с другими пользователями побороться за могущество и влияние в мире Азмары! 
 
Новички и умудренные в боях воины смогут начать своё путешествие в Karos с нуля, сражаясь бок о бок с монстрами, создавая гильдии и конкурируя за место в таблице рейтингов! 
 
Прокачайте уровень и добудьте самую лучшую экипировку первым на сервере, создавайте могущественные гильдии и боритесь за господство на руднике и право владеть замком! 
 
Совсем скоро стартуют уникальные соревнования и конкурсы для нового сервера, участвуя в которых вы можете побороться за ценные призы. 
 
Мы желаем всем, кто решил начать свои приключения в новом игровом мире Бернео, успехов и героических побед!

notes.content:
Greeting everyone,

As you may know, [b]Nikita Online[/b] has recently celebrated it's [b]24'th birthday![/b] It's a significant achievement for the first Russian game-developer company and great occasion to treat our players with generous packs of presents!

From tomorrow, online accounts will receive gifts for the character first logged in the game, during celebration week from [b]29.10.2015[/b] till [b]05.11.2015[/b]! It only requires you, to have character created through Steam client of the game. Date of the registration does not matter, everyone can have presents! Make sure you logging in with character, on which you want presents to be received. Otherwise, gift items will bound to other character.

Дорогие друзья,

Как вы уже знаете, [b]Nikita Online[/b] совсем недавно отметила свой [b]24'ый день рождения![/b] Это значительно достижение для первой в России компании-разработчика компьютерных игр и замечательный повод, чтобы порадовать своих пользователей отличным набором подарков!

С завтрашнего дня и до конца празднования (с[b] 29.10.15 11:00 до 05.11.15[/b]), зайдя в игру любым персонажем, вы получите набор призов! Для этого лишь требуется, чтобы ваш персонаж был создан через Steam клиент игры. Дата регистрации не имеет значения, каждый может получить подарки! notes.title: Global Update / Глобальное обновление: Война с Нежитью
notes.content:
Prepare for ultimate battle with Necromancers threat! Steel yourselves and solve the mystery of the new dungeons. Achieve new levels and master your skills! New global update is now live! Join the battle!

[b]New features[/b]:
- Maximum level raised to 105
- New legendary weapons to craft
- New equipment and armor
- New items
- New quests
- And many more!

[b]Introducing all new Heristum Dungeons[/b]:
- Necromancer’s Workroom
- The Lab

[h1][b]Отважные искатели приключений! [/b][/h1]

Пришло время узнать подробности глобального обновления в [b]Karos[/b]! Сегодня вы сможете узнать о новых устрашающих подземельях! Вход в лабораторию, где скрываются черные маги, надежно запечатан. Вам предстоит преодолеть множество опасностей, чтобы проникнуть в лабораторию и сразиться с силами зла. 

Глобальное обновление в [b]Karos[/b] готовит для нас много нового: 
[list]
[*]Повышение максимального уровня до 105 
[*]Новое легендарное оружие 
[*]Новая экипировка и доспехи 
[*]Новые предметы 
[*]Новые задания 
[*]И многое другое! 
[/list]

[h1][b]Мастерская некроманта[/b][/h1]

Сегодня вы узнаете, как отыскать ключ от темных залов [b]Лаборатории Некроманта[/b]. 
Сперва герои Азмары должны отправиться на штурм ужасающей [b]Мастерской Некроманта[/b], которую охраняет целая армия живых мертвецов, чтобы собрать фрагменты [b]Ключа Тьмы[/b]. 

Для того чтобы попасть в [b]Мастерскую Некроманта[/b], вы можете воспользоваться услугами телепортации у Нумирии в Эристуме. Для этого ваш персонаж должен иметь [b]100 уровень[/b] и заплатить [b]100 000 карат[/b]. 

[b]Мастерская Некроманта[/b] – это запутанный лабиринт, из которого придется найти выход каждому, кто хочет добраться до темных секретов и артефактов Лаборатории Некроманта. Это место стало настоящей тюрьмой для несчастных жертв экспериментов некромантии. Чтобы остановить вторжение героев, мертвецы вышли на свободу из своих тюремных камер. 

Исследуя кошмарный лабиринт мастерской, вам рано или поздно придется сразиться с жестокими надзирателями этой темницы: 
[list]
[*]Охранник-генерк 
[*]Охранник-варвар 
[*]Охранник-вентом 
[*]Охранник-эксильпортер 
[*]Охранник-тиран 
[/list]
Каждый из них держит при себе свою собственную часть [b]Ключа Тьмы[/b], пять фрагментов которого вам необходимо собрать. Как только вы одолеете охранников, добытые фрагменты ключа необходимо отнести Наджаропу, ремесленнику из Замка Каранин, для изготовления [b]Собранного ключа тьмы[/b]. 

Ключ тьмы дарует доступ к запретной [b]Лаборатории Некроманта[/b], но будет уничтожен после использования. Для того чтобы вновь зайти в лабораторию, вам понадобится изготовить новый ключ. 

Сражаясь с обитающей в [b]Мастерской Некроманта[/b] нежитью и охранниками вы сможете раздобыть обычную экипировку и оружие на 103 уровень. 

Чтобы попасть в [b]Лабораторию Некроманта[/b], необходимо отыскать в лабиринте мастерской секретный проход. Как только вы приблизитесь к нему, [b]Собранный ключ тьмы[/b] будет изъят из вашего инвентаря и вы переместитесь в новое подземелье. 

[h1][b]Лаборатория Некроманта[/b][/h1]

Наконец, вы попали в логово зла. Обитель некромантов является еще более опасным и запутанным лабиринтом, созданным для того, чтобы ни одна живая душа не смогла добраться до сердца лаборатории и узнать секреты внутреннего круга. 

Используйте свою смекалку и чутьё, чтобы добраться до предводителя некромантов в этом смертельном лабиринте их лаборатории. Найти его, не такая простая задача, но еще сложнее будет уничтожить его. Вам понадобится помощь всей гильдии для этого сражения! 

Сражаясь с некромантами в лаборатории, вы сможете раздобыть оружие и экипировку на 103 уровень. За победу над боссом у вас есть шанс получить могучее оружие на 103 уровень и новый предмет для ремесла – Адамантиум, который станет основой для изготовления нового легендарного оружия для персонажей достигших 105 уровня. 

[h1][b]Новая экипировка[/b][/h1]

Вместе с повышением максимального уровня до 105, героям Азмары станет доступна могущественная экипировка и оружие, которые вы сможете раздобыть в новых подземельях. Помимо этого, Несьер из Замка Каранин раскрыл секрет изготовления нового легендарного оружия 105 уровня. Но ему потребуется ваша помощь и материалы, чтобы сделать его. 

Для изготовления [b]Легендарного Оружия Священного Духа[/b] вам понадобятся: 
[list]
[*]Блестящий камень древнего знания [100 шт.] 
[*]Эссенция великого завоевателя [10 шт.] 
[*]Очищенный адамантий [1 шт.] 
[/list]

Следите за новостями, чтобы больше узнать о новом глобальном обновлении в [b]Karos[/b]!

Сражаясь с некромантами в лаборатории, вы сможете раздобыть оружие и экипировку на 103 уровень. За победу над боссом у вас есть шанс получить могучее оружие на 103 уровень и новый предмет для ремесла – Адамантиум, который станет основой для изготовления нового легендарного оружия для персонажей достигших 105 уровня. 

[h1][b]Новая экипировка[/b][/h1]

Вместе с повышением максимального уровня до 105, героям Азмары станет доступна могущественная экипировка и оружие, которые вы сможете раздобыть в новых подземельях. Помимо этого, Несьер из Замка Каранин раскрыл секрет изготовления нового легендарного оружия 105 уровня. Но ему потребуется ваша помощь и материалы, чтобы сделать его. 

Для изготовления [b]Легендарного Оружия Священного Духа[/b] вам понадобятся: 
[list]
[*]Блестящий камень древнего знания [100 шт.] 
[*]Эссенция великого завоевателя [10 шт.] 
[*]Очищенный адамантий [1 шт.] 
[/list]

Следите за новостями, чтобы больше узнать о новом глобальном обновлении в [b]Karos[/b]!

Санта просит вас найти пропавшие праздничные носки, злые монстры по всему миру украли их, одержав над ними победу, вы сможете вернуть их владельцу.

[*]Кольцо опыта (1 день) х1
[*]Счастливые серьги (1 день) х1

[*]Защита оружия х1
[*]Защита доспехов х1
[*]Зелье живучести игрового помощника х2
[/list]

А тех героев, кто принесет [b]35 Носков Санты[/b], добрый дедушка наградит Счастливым подарком Санты, в котором можно найти один из подарков:
[list]
[*]Огромное зелье здоровья х20
[*]Огромное зелье маны х20
[*]Зелье ускорения х10
[*]Азмаранская золотая монета х10
[*]Камень древнего знания х20
[*]Зелье концентрации (1 час) х1
[*]Ожерелье жизни (1 день) х1
[*]Кольцо опыта (1 день) х1
[*]Счастливые серьги (1 день) х1

[*]Зелье живучести игрового помощника х5
[*]Подарок с крыльями
[/list]

А [b]проведя в игре более 2 часов[/b], вы получите особенный Подарок от Санты, в нем вы найдете один из следующих предметов:
[list]

[*]Зелье ускорения х3
[*]Камень магии х1

[*]Экстракт врокиана х1
[*]Надгробная табличка х1
[*]Защита оружия х1
[*]Защита доспехов х1
[*]Огромное зелье здоровья х30
[*]Огромное зелье маны х30
[/list]

Поспешите попробовать на вкус Новый год и приятной вам игры!

notes.title: Karos Online — одна из самых популярных MMORPG на русском теперь в Steam!
notes.content:
Эпические осады, динамичные рейды, бескомпромиссные войны между фракциями и гильдиями, а также продвинутый крафтинг и уникальная Флетта-система  — классика жанра MMORPG, которую уже выбрали более 3 миллионов русскоговорящих игроков, стала доступна в Steam.
Специально к запуску игры в Steam российский издатель Karos Online открыл новый сервер под названием [b]«Бладстоун»[/b] — здесь созданы максимально комфортные условия для игроков, которые окажутся на континенте Азмара впервые. Отсутствие заведомо неравной конкуренции с игроками, проведшими в Karos Online много времени, позволит вам первым исследовать еще неизведанные земли и покорить пока никем не занятые высоты. 
Вперед — приключения ждут!
